_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Bottom analog and extreme fear factors imply one more flush leg is still possible before turn, yet no catalyst confirms immediate direction so stay flat-to-hold.
next_move.brains_agree: No; analyst wants Anger/HOLD while narrative offers no forward call — consensus caps at Capitulation (–1 rung) only
next_move.confirmed_if: btc_momentum_30d improves significantly and fear_greed rises above 20
next_move.invalidated_if: btc_momentum_30d falls further and fear_greed drops below 5
